[SWS_Fr_00575] ⌈The function Fr_GetSyncFrameList() shall perform the following
tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:
1. Read
the
list
of
syncframes
received
in
the
last
even
communication
cycle
on
channel
A
and
write
it
as
array
to
the
memory
location
Fr_ChannelAEvenListPtr.
2. Read
the
list
of
syncframes
received
in
the
last
even
communication
cycle
on
channel
B
and
write
it
as
array
to
the
memory
location
Fr_ChannelBEvenListPtr.
3. Read the list of syncframes received in the last odd communication cycle on chan-
nel A and write it as array to the memory location Fr_ChannelAOddListPtr.
4. Read the list of syncframes received in the last odd communication cycle on chan-
nel B and write it as array to the memory location Fr_ChannelBOddListPtr.
5. Return E_OK.
⌋
